cohort: 233,123 deliveries occurring between 1993 and 2013 at 'Soroka' University Medical Center, including 786 pregnancies with iSUA
finding: Isolated single umbilical artery (iSUA) is an independent predictor of adverse perinatal outcomes in term neonates.
mod_finding: Induction of labor and cesarean delivery were more common in pregnancies with an isolated single umbilical artery (iSUA).
